title: Droid Speedrun Timer
body:
This datapack can be added to a world to add a simple scoreboard speedrun timer. 

To add this to a world, add this datapack when creating a new world. The timer will start as soon as you join the world.

To stop the timer, type /trigger speedrun_stop in chat.

The timer will reset if you leave and join the world.

To know your exact speedrun time, take the value on the scoreboard next to your name and divide by 20, that will be your time in seconds.
